questions.question: What total counts as tiny enough to hide?

options.label: Under 5 EUR
options.adds: Hide any category whose total is under 5 EUR.

options.label: Under 10 EUR
options.adds: Hide any category whose total is under 10 EUR.

options.label: Under 1% of total
options.adds: Hide any category that is under 1% of the report total.

rewriteBeforeAnswers: Hide the tiny categories from the report, the ones with only a few euros spent next to the big ones. Done when the report no longer lists them and the existing tests still pass.
final: Hide the tiny categories from the report, the ones with only a few euros spent next to the big ones. Done when the report no longer lists them and the existing tests still pass. Hide any category whose total is under 10 EUR.
